# tebib_dns_zone (Resource)

A hosted DNS zone for one domain. Our nameservers only answer for it once you prove you control the domain: delegate it to `nameservers` at your registrar, or publish the TXT record `verification_txt_name` = `verification_txt_value` at your current DNS provider. Creating the zone doesn't wait for that: `state` stays `creating` and `status` `pending_verification` until then, and records can be added meanwhile. Deleting it stops serving the domain and deletes its records.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tebib_dns_zone" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}

# Delegate the domain to these at your registrar.
output "nameservers" {
  value = tebib_dns_zone.example.nameservers
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The domain, e.g. `example.com` (non-ASCII names are stored as punycode). Changing it replaces the zone.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description, at most 255 characters. Default: empty.
- `name` (String) Name, unique among the project's zones. Default: the domain. Changing it replaces the zone.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (`p-...`). Default: the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags (key-value pairs). IAM policies can match them. Default: none.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `delegation_ok` (Boolean) Whether the domain's delegation points at our nameservers (null: not checked yet).
- `id` (String) Zone ID (`zone-...`).
- `nameservers` (List of String) Delegate the domain to these at your registrar.
- `serial` (Number) The zone's SOA serial, once served.
- `served` (Boolean) Whether our nameservers answer for the zone.
- `state` (String) Lifecycle state: `active` once ready (or `error`).
- `status` (String) `pending_verification` (not served yet), `active`, `updating`, `error` (another account serves the domain, or publishing keeps failing) or `deleting`.
- `status_message` (String) What the platform last said about the resource.
- `trn` (String) TebibHost resource name (TRN), for IAM policies.
- `verification_method` (String) How the domain was proved: `ns`, `txt` or `staff`.
- `verification_state` (String) `pending`, `verified` or `conflict`.
- `verification_txt_name` (String) Name of the TXT record that proves control of the domain.
- `verification_txt_value` (String) Value of that TXT record.

### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <zone_id>, optionally with <project_id>/ in front.
terraform import tebib_dns_zone.example zone-abc123
```
